about: Every piece of code this repo borrows from outside (LIFE-635). tests/contracts/test_borrowed_code.py fails on any action, download or installer not listed here. level a = remove (replace with our own), b = vendor and pin, c = accepted exception.

actions.name: actions/cache
actions.reason: accepted exception: GitHub's own cache service has no other client; pinned by fingerprint (LIFE-640)

actions.name: ./.github/actions/sm-action
actions.reason: vendored copy of bitwarden/sm-action v3.0.1 (GPL-3.0, LICENSE kept), download and cargo fallback deleted (LIFE-636); the helper program stays SHA-256 checked

downloads.name: Node.js v24.22.3 (official tarball)
downloads.reason: downloaded from nodejs.org and unpacked only if its SHA-256 equals the one recorded in .github/actions/node/node.sha256 (LIFE-639); runs the Concord Room plugin tests

downloads.name: Tailscale client 1.94.2 (official tarball)
downloads.reason: downloaded from pkgs.tailscale.com and installed only if its SHA-256 equals the one recorded in .github/actions/tailscale/tailscale.sha256 (LIFE-637)

downloads.name: bws helper binary
downloads.reason: downloaded then checked against a committed fingerprint before use

downloads.name: Playwright Chromium and its system libraries
downloads.reason: the browser tests need a real Chromium (Playwright 1.47.0); Playwright publishes no fingerprint for its browser download, so this is an accepted exception, installed from Playwright and the runner image's packages (LIFE-640)

packages.name: @concord-ai/concord-mcp
packages.reason: Concord's MCP server, installed on Jim's Mac outside the repo at a pinned version (tools/orca-concord-room/README.md); all seven agent MCP configs call it by this absolute path, never by a PATH lookup

baselines.name: GitHub-hosted runner image ubuntu-24.04
baselines.reason: accepted baseline: the operating system, git, Python 3.12, curl and sudo the jobs run on; there is no alternative to the host image
